title: Supplement Brand Tax Accounting in Canada: Inventory, Product Costs & Cost of Goods Sold

rows.before: The 2026 Ontario Budget, tabled 26 March 2026, also reduced the provincial small business corporate income tax rate from 3.2% to 2.2% effective 1 July 2026, taking the combined rate on the first $500,000 of active business income from 12.2% to 11.2%, with a blended rate for year-ends straddling that date.
